zora: Even now I often achieve the unconscious Zora of Eatonville before the Hegira.
They deplored any joyful tendencies in me, but I was their Zora nevertheless.
I belonged to them, to the nearby hotels, to the county--everybody’s Zora.
I was not Zora of Orange County any more, I was now a little colored girl.
I left Eatonville, the town of the oleanders, as Zora.
